title: Space-time engineering with LASETRON pulses
abstract: The LASETRON project (Phys. Rev. Lett, 88, (2002), p. 074801-1) offers the possibility of the investigation of electron-positron structure of the space-time. Following our results (From Quarks to Bulk Matter, Hadronic Press, 2001) we analyze theoretically possibility of the penetration of zeptosecond laser pulses through space-time.   Key words: Zeptosecond laser pulses; LASETRON; Electron-positron pairs; Space-time.
